title: Introduction to Machine Learning (CS771A) - Autumn 2023 - IIT Kanpur
description: | Introduction to Machine Learning  CS771A  Autumn 2023 |. This course will be an introduction to the design (and some analysis) of Machine Learning algorithms, with a modern outlook, focusing on the recent advances, and examples of real-world applications of Machine Learning algorithms. This is supposed to be the first ("intro") course in Machine Learning. At the same time, please be aware that this is NOT a course about toolkits/software/APIs used in applications of Machine Learning, but rather on the principles and foundations of Machine Learning algorithms, delving deeper to understand what goes on "under the hood", and how Machine Learning problems are formulated and solved. | 1 | Course Logistics and Introduction to Machine Learning | ML article in Science, maths refresher slides | Python basics, NumPy basics | PPTX slides, PDF slides |. | 15 | Probabilistic Models for Supervised Learning: Generative Methods | PML-1: Chapter 9 | PPTX slides, PDF slides |.
